findings.finding: The 50,000,000 Class A shares sold at $0.15 in the best-efforts offering closed 2026-08-31 (10,000,000 shares at a $0.75 equivalent after the 2026-09-08 1-for-5 consolidation, about 94% of the ~10.6m Class A outstanding) carry no disclosed lock-up and are still in profit at the $1.00 screen price, so any unsold remainder can be sold into the 2026-10-06 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Unlocked, registered shares in profit can be sold on any session including 2026-10-06; no lock-up exists to delay them (424B4 discloses none; issuer's closing 6-K lists only the SPA and placement agency agreement).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the offering closed and the split took effect the stock ran to roughly $10 and then lost about 90% over three sessions (baseline events 2026-10-01 -79.36%, 10-02 -22.75%, today -22.47%); how much of that selling was the offering cohort is not disclosed.
findings.why_not_priced: Price at $1.00 is still 33% above the cohort's $0.75 cost, so the cohort has not been forced below basis; if the overhang were fully priced the stock would already sit at or under $0.75. Sized small because the cohort may largely have exited on the run to $10, which is unobservable.
findings.independence: Closing 6-K confirms 50M issued and no lock-up agreement among the listed agreements: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1990251/000121390026095769/ea0303934-6k_wellchange.htm

outside_window.finding: Bid price is at $1.0001; a close under $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days would start a Nasdaq 5550(a)(2) deficiency, and with a 1-for-400 consolidation approved 2026-07-06 plus the 1-for-5 of 2026-09-08 the cumulative reverse-split ratio exceeds 250, which under Nasdaq's 2025 rule removes the compliance period. Earliest possible trigger is mid-November 2026.

Placement agent Prime Number Capital holds a 9-month right of first refusal on future equity or debt offerings, signalling further financing is contemplated; no registration statement is currently effective for new issuance, so nothing can price inside the window.
